# gramlot-py-server 0.3.25

Aligns the Python hosts with Gramlot and examples 0.3.25. Includes shared lazy Markdown assets, reviewed uploader and Visual Editor host integration, Tree/dbSelect relation support and explicit caption_field selection through the Asqueel provider.

The public gallery retains the external English mobile catalogue and same-origin resources. Database demonstrations require their documented server/role configuration. Remote Edit stays disabled; Invoice application and TestFlight publication remain excluded.

Binary uploads are supported by Uvicorn; Kajenn and the other HTTP adapters do not yet expose that transfer protocol.

The documented Kajenn cancellation limitation is retained pending availability of its upstream fix in a release; the dated upstream verification is preserved separately.
